proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: Generous daily free credits (equivalent to ~300+ free FLUX.1-schnell or SDXL images per day via API).
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Provides incredibly fast, free API access to top-tier open-source models including FLUX.1-schnell, SDXL, and various LLMs with high concurrency and no complex setup.
proposals.would_integrate_where: GitHub Actions image generation workflow (`image_generation_status`), replacing or acting as a high-quality alternative to Pollinations and Together AI.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Based in China; ToS changes could restrict free tiers or require phone verification in the future. Needs a simple bearer token header.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: Free to list products. 88% revenue share for creators (Epic takes 12%).
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Consolidates Unreal Engine Marketplace, Sketchfab, and Quixel into one massive, unified marketplace for 3D models, 2D drafts, game templates, and textures.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Gamedev asset pack pipeline (`produce_gamedev_asset_pack`). The system can auto-package ZIPs and generate metadata templates ready for manual or semi-automated upload to Fab.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: High competition, assets must strictly meet Epic's quality standards, and manual curation is required during submission.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: No monthly fee. Pay-as-you-go model (5% + $0.50 per transaction).
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Acts as a Merchant of Record (MoR), meaning they handle EU VAT (TVA), invoicing, and global compliance automatically. Perfect for a French solo entrepreneur selling digital PDF/ZIP assets.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Can host checkout links for digital products (Coloring books, 3D parametric STL files, Gamedev packs) directly linked from free GitHub Pages sites.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Payout thresholds and slightly higher transaction fees compared to Stripe, but saves dozens of hours of VAT administrative overhead.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 2,500 free search queries upon registration. No credit card required.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Extremely fast and cheap Google Search, Images, and Shopping scraping API. Essential for getting real-time market trends without getting blocked by Google's anti-bot systems.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Within `agent_trendhunter` and `agent_niche_gap` to automatically look up top-selling KDP niches or trending Etsy search queries directly from GitHub Actions.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Once the 2,500 credits run out, you must register a new email or pay (though paid tier is extremely cheap: $1 per 1,000 queries).

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 100 free image generations per day via API.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Provides direct, reliable API endpoints for highly optimized models like SDXL, specialized LoRAs, and ControlNet, with excellent documentation.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Fallback generator in GitHub Actions when Pollinations/Together AI fail or hit rate limits, specifically for generating highly styled coloring book pages.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Images generated on the free tier may have rate limits during peak hours; strict content filters apply.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: Free conversion and distribution. They take a 10% cut of the retail price upon actual sale.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Distributes ebooks and paperbacks to a massive network of stores (Barnes & Noble, Kobo, Apple Books, Scribd) from a single upload, bypassing the need to register on 10 different platforms.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Low-content book and coloring book pipelines. Once a book is generated for Amazon KDP, the same PDF/EPUB can be pushed to Draft2Digital to maximize footprint.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Formatting requirements are strict; print-on-demand distribution options have specific margin requirements that must be handled in the PDF generation script.
